overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: Your balance, concurrency limit, and recent usage
overview.balanceHint: Available for public group calls; top-ups apply immediately
overview.recentEmpty: No usage in the last 7 days
overview.tutorialIntro: Follow these five steps from sign-up to your first call. Copy the endpoint and key directly on mobile.
overview.endpointHint: After creating a key, copy the endpoint and secret from My Keys. Use OpenAI-compatible mode in your client and choose a model shown in Channel monitor.

step1.title: Sign up and sign in
step1.desc: Open the site in your phone browser, tap Sign up, and enter your email, password, and confirmation. If a verification code appears, check your email and return to the form. Registration signs you in automatically; use the same credentials later.

step2.title: Create an API key
step2.desc: Open My Keys from the bottom navigation, tap New, enter a recognizable name, and select a public group. Leave concurrency and cumulative token limits unlimited at first if you are unsure. Create the key and keep its plaintext value handy.

step3.title: Copy the endpoint and configure your client
step3.desc: Use the copy icons on the key row to copy the endpoint and key separately. The endpoint is this site's address plus /v1; select OpenAI-compatible mode and copy a model name from Channel monitor. Do not append /v1 twice.

step4.title: Check channels and usage
step4.desc: Open Channel monitor to compare public-group calls, average latency, and success rate, then prefer a stable channel. After a call, open Usage logs to verify model, tokens, cost, latency, and error reason; data refreshes about every 30 seconds.

step5.title: Buy and redeem codes
step5.desc: Open the card-store link on Redeem, pay for a code, and copy it from the order page. Paste several codes here separated by newlines, spaces, or commas. Each code reports its own result, so fix failed items using the displayed reason.
